connector.name: Telegram MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Local-first TDLib Telegram MCP server with 110 tools, account isolation and production guardrails.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image telegram-mcp-tdlib:1.14.0-stdio. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tolboy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TDLIB_PHONE_NUMBER
env.description: Telegram phone number; omit after preparing a persisted session when using QR authentication

env.name: TDLIB_AUTH_CODE
env.description: One-time Telegram login code for a fresh headless container

env.name: TDLIB_2FA_PASSWORD
env.description: Telegram 2FA password when the account requires it

env.name: MCP_READ_ONLY
env.description: Keep true for safe first use

env.name: MCP_TOOL_PROFILE
env.description: Tool surface: reader, inbox, community-admin, research, or all
